business_problem: Chevron Phillips Chemical needed to modernize its digital tooling, expand its cloud footprint, and turn operational data into AI-assisted decisions that could improve reliability, production, and supply-chain performance.
solution_summary: Chevron Phillips Chemical and Capgemini built a data and AI foundation on Microsoft Azure to scale operational AI across manufacturing and supply-chain workflows. CPChem evaluated operations company-wide, identified 52 value cases, and narrowed them to high-value starting points based on impact, readiness, and effort. Capgemini helped design a pod-based delivery model and an Azure-centered platform that supports data engineering, machine-learning development, and cloud product delivery without waiting on fixed hardware. Manufacturing and supply-chain data flows into the platform, where digital tools and optimization models help teams improve reliability, production, and supply-chain visibility; the footprint can then extend into predictive maintenance, e-commerce, and asset information management. By combining cloud migration, product teams, and operational ML expertise, CPChem made digital transformation a repeatable way to launch tools workers can adopt and scale.
